data.name: Hunter's Tricks
data.description: A skirmisher ranger learns the use of %1 hunter's tricks, which typically grant a boon or bonus to the ranger or a nearby ally. A ranger can use these tricks %2 times per day. Tricks are usually swift actions, but sometimes move or free actions that modify a standard action, usually an attack action. Once a trick is chosen, it can't be retrained. A ranger cannot select an individual trick more than once. This ability replaces the ranger's spells class feature. Skirmishers do not gain any spells or spellcasting ability, do not have a caster level, and cannot use spell trigger and spell completion magic items.|SkirmisherTricks|SkirmisherTrickTimes
